proposals.problemSummary: Unclassified or ambiguous failure signature requiring manual triage by a Quality Engineer.
proposals.recommendedAction: Inspect Playwright trace zip, screenshot, and console logs. Reproduce manually to determine whether failure is SUT, test script, or environment defect.
proposals.rationale: Insufficient diagnostic evidence to formulate an automated repair proposal safely. Human QA investigation required before taking remediation action.
supportingEvidence: An obscure unclassified diagnostic failure occurred without stack trace
